label: momus makes one bounded release-readiness pass across nine areas A to I with a security lens on each, grading findings by evidence tier and confidence and by a four-level severity ladder; its deliverable is a written report and it files GitHub issues only when separately asked, never writing a ship or no-ship verdict.
desc: One invocation is one bounded pass: ORIENT, SCOPE, READ and PROBE, CROSS-CHECK, FALSIFY, REPORT, PERSIST. It covers nine areas A to I — tenant isolation and personal data, authentication and authorization with a business-process map, data and migrations, error handling and information leakage, configuration and secrets against CIS, resilience and silent-wrong-number risk, test coverage with direct-API proof, operational readiness, and contracts/code health — each with a security lens for outsiders and insiders. Evidence tiers T1 to T4 map to confidence CERTAIN, LIKELY or SUSPECTED; severity is BLOCKER, HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW. The deliverable is a written report; it files GitHub issues only when separately asked, never writes a ship or no-ship verdict, and keeps state under .momus/.
title: /momus — release-readiness auditor
